build.before_jsx:
(
CONFLUENCE · SOURCE CANDIDATE 10893 · 9 NOV 2026
Preserve what the source actually tells us.
PR10893 now pairs both historical baseline comparisons, removes the repeated recent-rate meter and aligns wrapped period rows. It retains the cached-reader fence, honest actions and actual successful-render overwrite proof from its previous increment. The 24 current R2 cards remain anatomy placeholders; populated values belong to source-bound fixtures. R4 below remains its preserved earlier proposal, not current-head proof.
01 · Existing source path
scripts/build_confluence_screener.py reads site/factordata/tech_confluence.json and renders the public page plus its protected payload. PR10705 supplies the existing source qualification and full artifact receipt. PR10893 @22fa830d preserves those rules and adds one PAYLOAD_SCHEMA constant, passed to both available/unavailable template contexts and protected JSON. Only this Confluence asset advances to tier_payload.v2. Invalid required input still yields unavailable, null counts and empty rows. No new loader or source owner. The comparison increment changes no builder or protected JSON.
02 · One availability branch
Use the existing qualification branch. Required source clock, coverage, split date, legs, IDs, active ticker lists and numeric evidence must pass _source_receipt(). Invalid required input means unavailable, not zero. A qualified artifact with combos.long=[] means available with zero eligible combinations. Otherwise _eligible_long_combos() selects active rows with both historical rates, orders by rank_score and supplies at most three cards. Preserve the same receipt and selection rule in both public and protected projections; add no loader, availability service or second selection owner.
03 · Missingness & clocks
A qualified receipt requires timezone-aware generated_utc. Missing, date-only or invalid source time makes the source unavailable and its matching count unknown. source_built is the full source-generation time; it is not a market observation clock. The template explicitly says market observation time is not supplied. The separate page generated_utc must never substitute for missing source time. Required period fire/month counts qualify the source; absent optional history, baselines, edges or consistency remain unknown. Preserve legitimate supplied zero/false without inventing a negative historical conclusion. Render edge_test_pp and edge_train_pp independently. Never derive a missing difference from displayed rates or detailed baseline levels. Exact zero is neutral 0.0; signed values below 0.1 percentage points keep two significant digits so a nonzero result cannot appear as zero.
04 · Counts, order & scope
n_active_total counts all eligible active combinations before the top-three cap. combos|length counts displayed cards, from zero to three; universe_n is separate source coverage. Current candidate headings and Showing N of M copy distinguish those scopes. Keep rank_score order and stable ties, combo_id, is_free and active_count. Zero means this qualified source contains no active combinations with readings for both periods. It does not mean all market signals are inactive. Do not fabricate rows, dates, ranks, legs or samples.
05 · Comparisons & primary controls
Each period keeps its monthly rate, months and fires, followed by its supplied baseline difference. Shared rows align labels and values; a visible percentage-point heading and independent definition-list terms bind the two comparisons. Use display rank for the heading ID: source IDs may contain spaces and must not be rewritten. The baseline definition remains in the native method disclosure. Eight R2 anatomy references now omit active-looking filter bars. All eight bars and four mobile filter sheets retain their original IDs on p-4-0. Current source has no filter implementation, so add none to this three-card main list. A future study would filter only supplied published combinations; define Weekly precisely and require a known consistency value. Never renumber ranks or make the first visible paid card free. A later hide/show implementation must preserve DOM identity for the incumbent one-time hydrator.
06 · Protected access stays separate
The existing MDXAuth/controller and protected endpoint remain the owners. Confluence now emits tier_payload.v2: the frozen old v1 reader rejects it, and the current reader rejects prior v1 responses. Matching v2 still requires the full source receipt, expected IDs, counts, unique tickers and existing authorization/lifecycle checks before any replacement. The full artifact hash already binds the recipe; add no second recipe identity. Version rejection uses the existing access check; a source-generation mismatch uses Reload latest page.
